item.title: How to use async/await in React data fetching
item.description: Fetching data asynchronously is a fundamental requirement for modern React applications, yet managing the lifecycle of these requests can be tricky. As a developer and the creator of CoreUI, I have implemented countless data-driven interfaces using React since 2014. The most efficient and modern solution is to define an internal asynchronous function within the useEffect hook to handle the request lifecycle. This approach provides a clean syntax that avoids “callback hell” and integrates seamlessly with React’s state management.
